SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO , MAX(IVHD.INV_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVHD.BUYER IN ( 'KRCHAN0060', 'KRCHAN0058', 'KRCHAN0059', 'KRDONG0708') AND IVHD.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO= IVDT.INV_NO AND IVHD.INV_TYPE = '0' AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE 'PO%' AND PODT.PLANT IN ('A0','B0','C0','D0') GROUP BY IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO UNION ALL SELECT IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO , MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVDT.BUYER IN ( 'KRCHAN0060', 'KRCHAN0058', 'KRCHAN0059', 'KRDONG0708') AND IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE 'PO%' AND PODT.PLANT IN ('A0','B0','C0','D0') GROUP BY IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO
